## Gap analysis (existing seams vs ticket scope)

The S6.1a campaign state machine already drove the human-proposed
family end-to-end; the ontology already carried `SearchBudgetRecord`,
`AdaptiveSearch`/`ValidationStrategy`, `CoordinationPolicy` and the
`coordination_delta` classifier arm; `hh-registry` already had the
class+suite registration pattern. What did not exist: the
`evolution_proposer` class + suite + first-party variant, the
automated-family admission gates, the two missing adaptive
strategies' allocators + engine dispatch + durable rows, the
`predictor` compute variant, the split-canary `RolloutPolicy` seam,
and the §5c corpus legs (memory lineage, guideline compaction).

| AC/leg | Landed | Where |
|---|---|---|
| `evolution_proposer` class + four-kind suite | `evolution_proposer_class()` / `evolution_proposer_suite()` — `exactly-one per campaign` cardinality, `instrument-grade`, ops `declare`/`select_parent`/`propose`/`run_conformance`, suite = static+contract+executable+property | `crates/hh-registry/src/suites.rs` (~1020/1137) · `corpus.rs` registration + suite back-patch |
| AHE-shaped variant, one class per campaign | `AheProposer` — `family = ahe`, `uses_judge = no`, deterministic/CPU-only, construction-time class pin; emits `Candidate`/`Hypothesis`/`NoAddressableFailure` (never `[]`); typed `ConstraintUnsatisfiable`/`BudgetExhausted`/`CorpusUnreadable` failures; `budget_slice_ppm` accounting | `crates/hh-evolution/src/proposer.rs` |
| Proposer conformance driver | `run_proposer_suite` over `ProposerPort` (`InProcessPort` for first-party); DRIFT/foreign-read probes; `SuiteDrive` | `crates/hh-evolution/src/proposer_conformance.rs` |
| Automated-family campaign gates | `protocol = automated` requires `proposer_variant_ref` + exactly one evolvable `target_class`; `Origin::Evolution` diffs under `automated` / human diffs under it refused (`InvalidProvenance`); `StaleBase` on head-moved bases; `coordination_delta = loosening` refused at S1 + S7; X6 self-modification (`SelfModificationRefused`); G7 `SelectorDeclaration` + honeypot floor + audit budget; G8 resolved + *complete* `SearchBudgetRecord` (+ `proposer` facet for automated families) | `crates/hh-evolution/src/campaign.rs` |
| Split canary under `RolloutPolicy` | `RolloutPolicy{mode, share_ppm, min_runs, max_duration_ms, abort_on[], advance_rule, assignment_seed}`; `split` committable only under a declared policy; the transition row carries `exploratory: true`, `comparable: false`, `assignment_seed`; `veto`/abort settle lands `reverted` with `CanaryAborted` | `crates/hh-evolution/src/{records,campaign}.rs` |

## Decisions

See **ADR-0322** — proposer-as-source (D1); one class construction-
pinned (D2); coordination loosening reuses the widening grammar (D3);
`memory_lineage` is a corpus layer, not a side channel (D4); proposer/
predictor spend rides the declared `SearchBudgetRecord` slice (D5);
adaptive strategies record-then-pick (D6); the OOP fixture leg is the
executable-kind witness (D7); `hh-registry` is kernel-side for
`hh-evolution` (D8).

## In-run fixes worth recording

- **`hh-embed` evolution test fixtures** carried literal
  `EvolutionCampaignSpec`/`CorpusSpec` initializers — the new members
  (`layers`, `proposer_variant_ref`, `target_class`, `rollout_policy`,
  `judge_policy`) were added to both literals (the strict-shape
  discipline holds: no `..Default` spreads in this codebase's specs).
- **`policy_for_refuses_unadmitted`** in `hh-control` still asserted
  `predictor` unadmitted — updated to assert admission (the ticket's
  own requirement) + the inert-without-slice leg.
- **Stale `hh-plugin-fixture` binary** in `target/` served
  `UnhandledOperation` on `declare` — the OOP leg needs
  `cargo build -p hh-plugin-fixture` first; the fixture binary is a
  build artifact the test spawns, and the workspace build order doesn't
  rebuild it for the test target. Recorded so the next OOP test knows.
- **Host-stamped outputs.** `invoke` outputs arrive stamped — a
  scalar `null` wraps as `{authority, origin, taint, value: null}`;
  object outputs are stamped in place. The test reads `o[0].value`.
- **`canary_settle` veto semantics** — a non-clean status lands the
  durable `reverted` row *and* returns `Err(CanaryAborted)`; the test
  asserts both halves.
- **A refused screen rejects the candidate** — subsequent legs need a
  fresh `propose` (matches s6_1a's per-leg candidate discipline).
- **Naming drift caught in-run:** `EntityKind::name()` is CamelCase
  (`"HarnessRule"`) — `allowed_target_kinds`/`allowed_kinds` spell it;
  the `RegistryStore` member list is `version_ids()` (the corpus's
  `build` return carries only variant ids); `EntityKind`×`allowed`
  empty-set mismatches surfaced as `ExcludedTarget{node:kind}` /
  `ConstraintUnsatisfiable` in the first battery run.
